title: UI Showcase 证据必须区分机制演示、生产证据与黄金基线
summary: 可运行 Reference Demo 能证明机制和交互契约，但不能冒充生产 UI 或视觉基线；生产截图/录屏证明某次真实实现，Golden Baseline 才承担受控状态下的视觉回归参照。Foundry 应显式标注这三种证据层级。
principles: Reference demo proves mechanism and interaction shape, not pixel identity.
Production evidence preserves provenance to the real product and state.
Golden baseline declares viewport/theme/state and supports visual regression.
Missing visual evidence is represented explicitly rather than substituted with a generated mock.
One Showcase may support multiple composable Patterns when the relationship is declared.
Visual baselines record source Showcase identity, viewport, browser/version and content hash so screenshot evidence is reproducible and attributable.
Baseline regeneration is an explicit repository change; it must not silently rewrite semantic Pattern contracts.
